top_choice_rationale: P001 honours induced proximity to an E3 ligase as a general chemical principle: a small molecule assembles a ternary complex whose cooperativity, selectivity and hook effect are measurable binding equilibria, supported by VHL and cereblon crystal structures and widely reproduced. Crews and Deshaies supply the engineered PROTAC concept and Handa the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide-class glues, so each name carries a distinct element of one principle. The residual cost is that no degrader is yet approved and Ciulli is omitted by the three-name limit, but this is a better-grounded and better-supported award than the alternatives.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Lund colleague of Linke and Somfai is not a tie to any credited laureate
